# Flaspek

> Flaspek is an iPhone app that turns the phone into a sign. The user speaks, and the words fill the screen in giant letters: a scrolling LED-style banner (marquee), one big word at a time, or a static multi-line poster. No typing needed. iOS 26.4 or later. App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6762515189

App Store name: "Flaspek: LED Banner & Big Text". Developer: Viktor Gorbatiuk (solo developer). Support: vibeprogerai@gmail.com. Version 1.02 (October 2026).

## What it is for

Being seen or read from a distance: concerts and matches (fan sign), airport arrivals and pickups (name sign), loud bars and parties, dark rooms, car windows, and talking to someone who cannot hear you (Conversation mode: they speak, you read).

## How it works

1. Tap the microphone, say the message, tap Show. The sign goes fullscreen at maximum brightness.
2. Pinch to resize, drag up or down to change speed, swipe down to exit.
3. Live mode: tap Live and every word appears on the sign as it is spoken. Squeeze AirPods to start a new line hands-free.

## Features

- Three display modes: Scroll (marquee, any direction or bounce), Word by word (RSVP-style big text), Poster (static multi-line sign that fits the screen).
- Effects: glow, neon, rainbow, pulse, flicker, fire, trail. 12 presets: Concert, Sport, Airport, Pickup, Outdoor, Conversation, Love, Party, Neon, SOS, Minimal, MAX. Fonts, weights, colors, gradients.
- Speech recognition in 16 languages (English, Chinese, Hindi, Spanish, French, Arabic, Portuguese, Russian, Indonesian, German, Japanese, Turkish, Korean, Italian, Ukrainian, Polish) plus Auto. Provided by Apple; needs internet for most languages.
- Spoken punctuation and symbols: "comma", "question mark", "heart sign", "star sign", "arrow sign" (Russian: "запятая", "вопросительный знак", "сердечко", "звёздочка", "стрелочка").
- One-tap re-record in another language when a sentence is misheard.
- Live translation of the sign into another language, including while speaking.
- Share as a video loop (1080p) or a poster image.
- Favorites and Recents (last 20 shown messages).
- Siri and Shortcuts: "Show my sign in Flaspek", "Start live in Flaspek".
- Auto-off timer (30 s to 2 h) with optional countdown on the sign, gesture lock, mirror mode, pause when the phone goes into a pocket.
- App interface localized in 15 languages.

## Pricing

Free: every style, effect, Live mode and favorites; 2 shows per calendar day (a show = a new message going fullscreen; re-showing the same message is free). Flaspek Pro lifts the daily limit: weekly auto-renewable subscription or a one-time lifetime unlock. Prices are set per country in the App Store. Cancel in iPhone Settings > Subscriptions; restore purchases from the Flaspek Pro screen in the app.

## Privacy

No accounts, no analytics, no tracking, no ads. Messages, favorites and settings are stored only on the device; deleting the app deletes everything. Microphone is used only while recording. Speech recognition is performed by Apple. Purchases go through the App Store.
